body:
Here's the Jetson Thor result. Jetson AGX Thor (aarch64), JetPack 7.2.1 (L4T R39.2), Ubuntu 24.04, CPU only (`LEROBOT_TEST_DEVICE=cpu`). Python 3.12.3, Torch 2.11.0+cu130, Gymnasium 1.4.0, NumPy 2.2.6.

I ran the four-file command from the description:

| Source | Result |
|---|---|
| `0f5d988` (current head) | 48 passed |
| base `24f15b9` + `tests/scripts/test_eval_terminal_observations.py` from `0f5d988` | 40 passed, 8 failed |

The 8 base failures are the `SameStep` cases of `test_episode_data_retains_terminal_observations` (state and nested_rgb, terminated and truncated, sync and async). Neither run had skips.

I tested `0f5d988` instead of `5166b72` because the fixture change is the only difference. Linux has `forkserver`, so the async cases used it here, and the `spawn` fallback wasn't exercised on this machine.

(Reply drafted with AI assistance.)
